name: baccarat-playtech-full-width-full-length
label: Playtech — Full Width / Full Length
captureTarget: The whole casino window: table, betting area and result strip.
ocrUse: Reads Banker/Player/Tie and, if you enable it, card values.
notes: Safest starting point, and the slowest to read. Prefer a tighter region once you have calibrated. Playtech runs a wider table, so a half-width region may need to be wider. Run calibration with your casino window open before enabling OCR; this region is a starting point, not a measurement.
